Subject: Re: Fwd: Crestview executive call — prep + credit math

Short RCA summary (for slides):
- Root cause: regressions in autoscaler heuristics combined with a regressed memory allocation path in a recent runtime patch (deployed 11/12).
- Sequence: autoscaler undershot target pool size during a transient surge -> KV cache pressure -> OOMs and elevated 5xx on queuing layer.
- Mitigation already applied: rollback of the runtime patch (11/15 08:10 PST) and temporary disablement of autoscaler optimization rules.
- Next steps: formal patch to allocator (ETA 11/20), autoscaler improvements (ETA 12/03), and better alerting for KV cache pressure (ETA 11/22).

Credit calc (summary):
- Affected window: 2026-11-13 22:00 PST — 2026-11-15 07:00 PST (33 hours)
- Measured SLA shortfall: 12.8% for that window vs our monthly target for dedicated pool uptime
- Proposed remediation: pro-rate credit of 12.8% of monthly committed fee for Nov 2026 = $31,200 (based on current committed spend).

I’ll attach the populated worksheet.

-Vivek
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
